_about: Public screening log of the Atlas. Hand-maintained in the repo by the daily check (not in Airtable), like negative_results.json. Each run records where and when the search looked and what it found; each decision records one candidate with the reason. Only what the check actually recorded is entered; counts that were not recorded are null. Currently covers the 'On the horizon' watch only; screening of the main corpus is added as the daily check starts writing candidate-level entries.

scopes.title: On the horizon: trials and preprints
scopes.bar: A trial or preprint is listed only if it asks about the temporal dynamics of mTOR: oscillation, pulses, time courses, circadian regulation, or dosing schedule as the question. Studies of mTOR with standard continuous dosing, and studies of other pathways, do not qualify.
scopes.query: ClinicalTrials.gov: rapamycin, sirolimus, everolimus or mTOR combined with autophagy, ageing or longevity, active recruiting statuses. bioRxiv and medRxiv: cell biology and molecular biology preprints in a rolling window of 3 to 30 days.

not_yet_logged: Weekly screening of the bims-auttor digest (biomed.news) for the main corpus: only issue dates are kept, not per-paper decisions.
Daily PubMed check for the main corpus: new studies are added to the Atlas, but rejected candidates and reasons have not been recorded.
